content.text:
I submitted **index 16** (Sb 0.66 / Zn 0.34, the ZnSb2O6 composition) as the best composition, but its EQE is very low (0.00098%). The library contains unmeasured compositions that could be better. I used all three merit measurements and all five XRD scans.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.22 | 0.000036 |
| 16 | 0.66 | 0.00098 |
| 23 | 0.82 | −0.00032 |

- **Model predictions didn't hold up.** The band-gap model put the Zn-rich phase (index 0) and the Sb-rich phase near index 23 at or below the 2.1 eV illumination, so both should have absorbed. Neither responded. The model also gave ZnSb2O6 a 1.97 eV gap, while I recall about 3.4 eV from the literature, so its gap numbers aren't reliable here.
- **My last measurement didn't pay off.** For it, I picked index 23 by extending the rise in EQE toward the Sb-rich end instead of taking the Gaussian-process suggestion (index 20). Index 23 came back negative, so the best response is somewhere in the middle of the line. Neighbours of index 16, and index 20, were never measured.
- **The XRD scans added little.** The strongest peaks (Q ≈ 2.79, 4.55 and 5.33 Å⁻¹) show up at every composition. They are probably from the substrate. The phase-specific peaks were weak, and I didn't match any of the scans against simulated patterns.
